description: This file defines functions and data structures for managing malfunction/error codes in firmware, including adding, removing, and retrieving error codes.

methods.name: initMalfunctionCentral
methods.description: Initializes the error codes set to empty.

methods.name: addError
methods.description: Adds an error code to the set if not already present.

methods.name: removeError
methods.description: Removes an error code from the set if present.

methods.name: setError
methods.description: Sets or clears an error code based on boolean isError.

methods.name: getErrorCodes
methods.description: Copies current error codes into provided structure.

methods.name: hasErrorCodes
methods.description: Checks if any error codes are currently set.
